queries_run: Royal Caribbean Cruises market share gaining OR losing 2026
Royal Caribbean new entrant competition MSC Viking Virgin Voyages capacity share 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 列示主要郵輪對手：Carnival、Disney、MSC、Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings、Viking、Virgin Voyages；公司自稱在逾兆美元全球度假市場中占比小
findings.excerpt: Our principal cruise competitors are Carnival Corporation & plc, which owns, among other brands, Aida Cruises, Carnival Cruise Line, Costa Cruises, Cunard Line, Holland America Line, P&O Cruises, Princess Cruises and Seabourn; Disney Cruise Line; MSC Cruises; Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Ltd, which owns Norwegian Cruise Line, Oceania Cruises, and Regent Seven Seas Cruises; Viking, and Virgin Voyages.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：公司依賴旅行顧問訂位，若佣金不具競爭力，顧問可能轉賣對手郵輪
findings.excerpt: If we fail to offer competitive compensation packages or fail to maintain our relationships, these agencies may be incentivized to sell cruises offered by our competitors, which could adversely impact our operating results.

findings.claim: 2026 加勒比海運力：RCI 占約 30%、Carnival 25%；RCL 加勒比運力年增 9%，NCLH 增 55%、MSC 增 23%
findings.source: Cruise Industry News: Caribbean Continues to Claim Lion's Share of Market
findings.excerpt: deployed in the Caribbean. MSC Cruises is third largest with a 10 percent market share and 37 percent of its capacity, followed by Norwegian Cruise line also with a 10 percent market share and 53 percent of its capacity deployed. Norwegian Cruise Line has the highest year-over-year capacity increase with 55 percent; MSC has a 23 percent increase from 2025; Royal Caribbean, 9 percent;

findings.claim: Port Economics 2026：Big-4 占部署船隊 78.9%，Virgin Voyages 1.4%
findings.source: Port Economics Management: Market Share of Main Cruise Lines, 2026
findings.excerpt: 629,433 berths, representing a deployed capacity of 30.30 million passengers, or 78.9% share of the total deployed fleet. Disney Cruises, with a 2.9% share of the deployed capacity, tops the list of the other cruise lines. In comparison, the comparatively recently established Virgin Voyages holds a notable 1.4% of the deployed market capacity.
